about.li2: Interests: Apple platforms, game systems, and 3D workflows

meta.title: EchoMind — Voice Notes to Clear Actions
meta.description: EchoMind transforms voice recordings into transcriptions, summaries, and actionable notes.

brand.name: EchoMind
brand.tagline: Voice capture, structured notes, and follow-up clarity

hero.title: EchoMind
hero.subtitle: Record a thought. Get a clean note.
hero.intro: EchoMind is an iOS voice-first notes app in active development. It captures spoken thoughts and turns them into transcripts, summaries, and clearer next actions.
hero.status_note: This is not the final version. UI and feature depth are actively improving over time.

flow.title: Current prototype flow
flow.li1: Home screen with one-tap recording and quick entry points for ideas, study, and tasks.
flow.li2: Library with recordings, timestamps, and duration previews.
flow.li3: Recording details with playback, transcription, and summary blocks.
flow.li4: Translate actions for transcript and summary from the same screen.
flow.li5: Settings for model selection, language, sounds, haptics, storage, and export defaults.

ai.title: AI output today
ai.text: The current output in screenshots already shows structured interpretation beyond plain text conversion.
ai.li1: Detects likely reference types (for example plans/schedule, humor/phrase).
ai.li2: Highlights date and time cues found inside free speech.
ai.li3: Supports quick re-transcribe and re-summarize iterations.
ai.li4: Adds translation hooks to keep notes accessible across languages.

roadmap.title: What is coming next
roadmap.text: The near-term direction is to make EchoMind more dependable for daily planning and multilingual note workflows.
roadmap.li1: Cleaner recording organization and faster search.
roadmap.li2: More robust extraction of tasks, dates, and reminders.
roadmap.li3: Stronger sharing/export combinations for audio + text summaries.
roadmap.li4: Ongoing UI refinements driven by real usage feedback.

footer.note: EchoMind is in active development and this page will evolve together with the app.

sashastudy.metaTitle: Sasha Study — Make room for learning
sashastudy.metaDescription: A native study app for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Organize materials, review flashcards and prepare for exams with Sasha Study.
sashastudy.eyebrow: A little structure. More room to learn.
sashastudy.title: Your study routine, in one place.
sashastudy.intro: Bring your materials, flashcards and exam plans together. Sasha Study helps you turn a big subject into a manageable daily routine.
sashastudy.heroNote: Built for Mac · iPhone & iPad preview
sashastudy.previewCaption: Actual Mac app · German interface · Open the screenshot at full size
sashastudy.routineEyebrow: From scattered notes to a daily rhythm
sashastudy.routineIntro: A personal study project, built around the way a student actually prepares for exams.
sashastudy.learnText: Review flashcards with spaced repetition, practise mistakes and test yourself with quizzes.
sashastudy.planText: Keep exam dates, tasks and notes together. Use the focus timer and timed mock exams to prepare.
sashastudy.materialText: Import documents, search their extracted text and connect questions to the material they came from.
sashastudy.listenText: Nachtvorlesung reads questions and answers aloud with adjustable pauses, speed and duration.
sashastudy.privacyText: Progress and study materials stay local by default. No advertising. No analytics. Export a backup when you need one.
sashastudy.privacyNote: Backups include study data and extracted text. Keep a separate copy of your original imported files.
sashastudy.platformTitle: Study at your desk. Review on the go.
sashastudy.macText: The Mac version includes the material library, study tools, spoken lectures, reminders and a widget. Requires macOS 14 or newer.
sashastudy.mobileText: The mobile preview brings daily sessions, exams, materials and spoken lectures to iPhone and iPad. Requires iOS or iPadOS 17 or newer.
sashastudy.availability: A personal project in active development. A public download is not available here yet; the mobile app is a preview.
sashastudy.faq1q: Does importing a document create questions?
sashastudy.faq1a: No. Import extracts searchable text. You can create questions yourself and link them to your materials.
sashastudy.faq2a: Not in the current distributed preview. Data stays local; automatic cross-device sync is not enabled.
sashastudy.faq3a: Included material covers Computer Architecture, ERP/SAP and Law. You can also add your own questions, materials and exams.
sashastudy.closingTitle: Made for learning. Built by Sasha.
sashastudy.closingText: Sasha Study began as a way to prepare for university exams and grew into a native study app. See the other projects behind it.
sashastudy.cardText: A native study companion with flashcards, quizzes, exam planning and your own materials.
sashastudy.todayAlt: Sasha Study Mac dashboard in its dark green theme, with daily learning goal and review schedule.
sashastudy.questionsDetail: Browse your questions, read explanations and practise what needs attention.
sashastudy.questionsAlt: The Mac question library with subject filters and questions with answers.
sashastudy.lectureDetail: A quieter way to review, with adjustable voice, pace and thinking pauses.
sashastudy.lectureAlt: The Mac Nachtvorlesung screen with voice, speed and pause settings.
